sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 138:1
items.html: (to question) Three actions result from this: The first is the departure of the light from all four phases. The second is that a place was made for the worlds. The third is the vessels of the ten Sefirot of circles. (Inner Observation, item 4)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 139:1
items.html: (to question) 1. The light of the line of Ein Sof on only three phases. 2. The correction of the screen that limits and detains the light from expanding in phase four. (There, item 5)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 140:1
items.html: (to question) 1. The coupling by striking with the upper light. 2. Pushing back the light that belongs to phase four, called reflected light. (There, item 6)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 141:1
items.html: 1. Potential and actual reception of the upper light, called Rosh and Guf. 2. Rejection of the upper light from phase four that manifests de facto in the screen of Tabur, which expands into ten forces of Sium, called the ten Sefirot of NHY, or the ten Sefirot of Sof. (There, item 9)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 141:2
items.html: (to question) (For the emanation of Partzuf AB of AK)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 142:1
items.html: (to question) The clash of surrounding light and inner light with one another. (There, item 12)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 143:1
items.html: (to question) 1. The refinement of the screen until it equalizes with the discernment of Malchut of the Rosh for renewal in the coupling of Rosh. 2. The incorporation of the screen in the records of the ten Sefirot of the Guf as it ascends. 3. The concealment of the record of drawing from the last discernment. (There, items 12, 13 and 18)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 144:1
items.html: (to question) 1. The concealment of the light of Keter and the diminution of the level up to Hochma. 2. Two upper records that became male and female. (There, items 14 and 19)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 145:1
items.html: (to question) 1. The ascent of Malchut of the Rosh to Hotem of the Rosh, which is phase three. 2. The coupling was made there on phase four of clothing, meaning on the discernment of the male, extending the level of Keter there, which is not in the discernment of expansion for the vessels. 3. The coupling on phase three was made there, meaning on the discernment of the female, extending the level of Hochma, which has expansion from above downward to the discernment of the vessels. (There, item 15)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 146:1
items.html: (to question) 1. The renewal of the coarseness in the screen and the records until they are suitable for a coupling by striking with the upper light. 2. The revelation of the coarseness of Guf in the screen and the records. (There, items 16 and 17)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 147:1
items.html: (to question) 1. Their exit from the Rosh and their arriving at their corresponding discernment in the externality of the Guf of Partzuf Galgalta, meaning in phase three of the Guf, called Chazeh. 2. That two couplings are made there in the place of Chazeh of Galgalta of the male and the female, according to their property in the Rosh. (There, item 19)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 148:1
items.html: 1. That the ten Sefirot of Rosh come out from the Chazeh upward to the Peh of Partzuf Galgalta on the level of Hochma. 2. The ten Sefirot from the Chazeh downward to the discernment of clothing, called Guf. 3. The ten Sefirot of Sium that expand from the screen of Tabur downward, which end above the Tabur of Partzuf Galgalta. This expansion of Rosh-Toch-Sof is called Partzuf AB of AK. (There, items 20, 21 and 22)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 148:2
items.html: (to question) (For the emanation of Partzuf SAG of AK)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 149:1
items.html: (to question) The clash of surrounding light and inner light with one another. (There, item 12)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 150:1
items.html: (to question) The first is the refinement of the screen until it equalizes with Malchut of the Rosh for renewal in the coupling of the Rosh. The second is the incorporation of the screen through its ascent in the records of the ten Sefirot of the Guf. The third is concealment of the record of drawing from the last discernment. (There, items 12, 13 and 18)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 151:1
items.html: (to question) The first is the concealment of the light of Hochma and the diminution of the level up to Bina. The second is two upper records that became male and female. (There, items 14 and 24)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 152:1
items.html: (to question) The first is the ascent of Malchut of the Rosh to the Ozen, which is phase two of the Rosh. The second is that the coupling on phase three of clothing was made there, meaning on the discernment of the male, extending the level of Hochma, which is not in the discernment of expansion for the vessels. The third is the second coupling that was made there on phase two, which is the discernment of the female, which draws the level of Bina, and has expansion to the discernment of the vessels. (There, item 15)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 153:1
items.html: (to question) The first is the renewal of the coarseness in the screen and the records until they are suitable for a coupling by striking with the upper light. The second is the disclosure of the coarseness of the Guf in the screen and the records. (There, items 16 and 17)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 154:1
items.html: (to question) The first is their exit from the Rosh and their arriving at their corresponding discernment in the externality of the Guf of Partzuf AB, meaning in phase two of AB, called Chazeh. The second is that they return and make two couplings there in the place of Chazeh of AB, like the attribute of the two couplings that they made by the incorporation in the coupling of the Rosh of AB. (There, items 19 and 24)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 155:1
items.html: The first is that the ten Sefirot of Rosh came out from the Chazeh and above up to the Peh of Partzuf AB on the level of Bina, which is in the discernment of the female, from whom there are the vessels of the Partzuf. However, there is also the level of Hochma there from the discernment of the male, who has no expansion to the vessels. The second is the ten Sefirot from the Chazeh of AB downward, which expand in the vessel of Keter of the Guf to the Tabur of Partzuf Galgalta. It reaches the Sium Raglayim of Partzuf AB, where this expansion stops because there is light of the level of male there, which is Hochma. The third is the expansion of the nine lower Sefirot from Tabur down to the Sium Raglayim of Galgalta of AK, called Nekudot of SAG. The fourth is the ten Sefirot of Sium that expand by the screen of Tabur, called the ten Sefirot of NHY, or ten Sefirot of the Sof of the Partzuf. This expansion of Rosh-Toch-Sof is called Partzuf SAG of AK.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 155:2
items.html: (For the emanation of Partzuf MA and BON of AK)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 155:3
items.html: (to question) called the world of Nekudim, or BON.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 156:1
items.html: (to question) The clash of surrounding light and inner light with one another.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 157:1
items.html: (to question) The refinement of the screen until it equalizes with Malchut of the Rosh to receive renewal from the coupling of the Rosh. The second is the incorporation of the screen in two kinds of records: records that are not connected with the records of NHY of Galgalta, called Taamim [tastes], and records that are connected with the NHY of Galgalta, called Nekudot, where the two Heys, the first Hey and the bottom Hey, are connected. The third is the concealment of the records of drawing from the last discernment. (There, items 12, 13, 18 and 25)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 158:1
items.html: (to question) The diminution of the level to phase one. The second is the two upper records that became male and female. (There, items 14 and 15)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 159:1
items.html: (to question) The ascent of Malchut of the Rosh to the Nikvey Einayim. The second is that the coupling on phase two of clothing was made there, meaning on the discernment of the male that the level of Bina is extended on, which is not the discernment of expansion to the vessels. This is performed over the above two kinds of the records: Taamim and Nekudot. The third is the coupling that was made there in the discernment of the female, meaning on phase one, which the level of ZA is extended on. However, she has expansion to the vessels, and this is done on two kinds of records, too: Taamim and Nekudot. (There, items 15 and 30)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 160:1
items.html: (to question) The first is the renewal of the coarseness in the screen and the records that rose from the Guf of SAG until they are suitable for a coupling by striking with the upper light. The second is the exit of the Dikna as bottom Hey in the Einayim and YHV in the AHP. The third is the disclosure of the coarseness of the Guf in the screen and the records. (There, items 16 and 17, and in Inner Light, page 391, the passage beginning “Hairs”)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 161:1
items.html: (to question) Their exit from the Rosh and their coming to the corresponding discernment in the externality of the Guf of SAG. (Inner Observation, item 19)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 162:1
items.html: (to question) 1. It elicited three Roshim as it came to three places in the Guf: in the Chazeh, in the Tabur, and in the Sium of the Guf. From the Chazeh to the Peh of SAG, it elicited the ten Sefirot of Rosh of the upper MA and BON, and its ten Sefirot of the Guf end at the Tabur. From the Tabur to the Chazeh of SAG, it elicited the ten Sefirot of Rosh called YESHSUT, or the first Rosh of Nekudim. From the Sium of the Guf, meaning Tifferet of AK to the Tabur, it elicits the GAR of Nekudim. From the Sium of the Guf downward, emerged the Guf of Nekudim, which are ZAT of Nekudim. In all of them, there are male and female. The level of male is up to Bina, and the level of female is the level of ZA. (There, items 20, 21, 22, 24 and 30)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 163:1
items.html: (to question) The diminution of Atzilut on Keter and Hochma alone, and AHP of every degree, are considered the Beria of that degree. Second: A new boundary of the Sium of the line of Ein Sof that rose from Malchut of NHY of AK to Bina of NHY of AK, and the emergence of the three Sefirot Bina, ZA, and Malchut of NHY of AK below the point of restriction. This is called the second restriction. Third: These three Sefirot below the point of restriction became the place for the three worlds BYA: The world of Beria was made in the place of Bina, the world of Yetzira in the place of ZA, and the world of Assiya in the place of Malchut. Fourth: the correction of the Parsa. (There, item 30, the passage beginning “And behold,” and items 33 and 34)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:1
items.html: Because of the craving for greater adhesion, meaning equivalence of form with the upper light, Malchut of Ein Sof restricted the discernment of Gadlut [greatness/adulthood] of the will to receive, meaning that she did not want to receive in phase four. Since phase four was the entire vessel of reception for the upper light, the light departed from all four phases, and a vacant place was made for the worlds.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:2
items.html: From the departure of the light from all four phases results the correction of a screen over phase four, in order to draw the light over the first three phases so that it will not expand to phase four.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:3
items.html: From the screen that was corrected over phase four, a coupling by striking with the upper light is extended in it, which returns all that portion of the light fit to come to phase four backward, called reflected light.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:4
items.html: From the coupling by striking and the reflected light that ascended, two actions are extended: 1. The discernment of potential and actual reception of the upper light, called Rosh and Guf, down to the Tabur. 2. The force of rejection over the ten Sefirot of upper light, called the screen of Tabur, from which ten forces of Sium expand, called the ten Sefirot of Sof, or the ten Sefirot of NHY.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:5
items.html: (From Galgalta to AB.)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:6
items.html: From the screen of Tabur, a clash of surrounding light and inner light with one another is extended.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:7
items.html: From the clash of surrounding light and inner light with one another, three actions are extended: 1. The refinement of the screen and its coming to renew the coupling in the Rosh, as a result of which all the lights of the Guf departed. 2. The incorporation of the screen in the records of the Guf during its ascent. 3. The concealment of the record of drawing from the last discernment.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:8
items.html: From the concealment of the record of drawing from the last discernment, two actions are extended: 1. The concealment of the light of Keter and the diminution of the level to Hochma. 2. The two upper records became male and female.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:9
items.html: From the two records, male and female, three actions are extended: 1. The ascent of Malchut of the Rosh to the Hotem, which is phase three of the Rosh. 2. A coupling was made there over phase four of clothing, meaning over the discernment of the male, and the level of Keter was extended there; it is not in the discernment of expansion to the vessels. 3. A second coupling was made there over phase three, meaning over the discernment of the female, and the level of Hochma was extended there, from which there is expansion to the vessels.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:10
items.html: From the two couplings of ZON that were made through their incorporation in the Rosh of Galgalta, the renewal of the coarseness in the screen and the records was extended until they became fit for a coupling by striking with the upper light. 2. The revelation of the coarseness of the Guf in the screen and the records.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:11
items.html: From the revelation of the coarseness of the Guf in the screen and the records, their exit from the Rosh and their arrival at their corresponding discernment in the externality of the Guf of Partzuf Galgalta are extended. This is phase three of the Guf, called Chazeh. 2. They made here, at the place of the Chazeh, the same two couplings that were made over their discernment in the Rosh.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:12
items.html: From the two couplings that the male and female made at the place of the Chazeh, three actions are extended: 1. The emergence of ten Sefirot of Rosh from the Chazeh upward to the Peh of Partzuf Galgalta at the level of Hochma. 2. The ten Sefirot expanded from the Chazeh downward, called Guf, to the screen of its own Tabur. 3. The ten Sefirot of Sium expanded from the screen of Tabur and ended above the Tabur of Partzuf Galgalta. This expansion of RTS is called Partzuf AB of AK.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:13
items.html: (From AB to SAG.)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:14
items.html: From the screen of Tabur of AB, a clash of surrounding light and inner light with one another is extended. (Inner Observation, item 12)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:15
items.html: From the clash of surrounding light and inner light, three actions are extended: 1. The refinement of the screen to equalize with Malchut of the Rosh in order to be renewed in a coupling, together with which the lights of the Guf depart. 2. The incorporation of the screen, during its ascent, in the records of the ten Sefirot of the Guf. 3. The concealment of the record of drawing from the last discernment.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:16
items.html: From the concealment of the last discernment of drawing, the concealment of the light of Hochma and the diminution of the level to Bina are extended. 2. The two upper records were formed into male and female.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:17
items.html: From the two records, male and female, the ascent of Malchut of the Rosh to the Ozen is extended. 2. A coupling was made there over phase three of clothing, which is the discernment of the male, and ten Sefirot at the level of Hochma are extended there, but it has no expansion to the vessels. 3. A second coupling was made there over phase two, which is the discernment of the female, and the level of Bina is extended, which expands to the vessels.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:18
items.html: From the two couplings made in the Rosh in the discernments of male and female are extended: 1. The renewal of coarseness in the screen and records until they are fit for a coupling by striking with the upper light. 2. The revelation of coarseness of the Guf in the screen and records.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:19
items.html: By the force of the revelation of coarseness of the Guf in the screen and records, their exit from the Rosh and their arrival at their corresponding discernment in the Guf of AB are extended, meaning in phase two, called Chazeh. 2. They return and make two couplings there in the Chazeh of AB, as they did in the Rosh.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:20
items.html: From the two couplings of male and female made in the Chazeh of AB, four actions are extended: 1. Ten Sefirot of Rosh emerged from the Chazeh upward to the Peh of Partzuf AB at the level of Bina, which is the discernment of the female, from which there is expansion to the vessels of the Partzuf. However, there is also the level of Hochma there, which is the male of the Partzuf and has no expansion to the vessels. 2. The ten Sefirot from the Chazeh of AB downward expand in the vessels of Keter of the Guf to the Tabur of Partzuf Galgalta, where that expansion stops. 3. The nine lower Sefirot expand to the Sium Raglayim of Galgalta of AK, called Nekudot of SAG. 4. The screen of Tabur, from which the ten Sefirot of Sium expand. This expansion of RTS is called Partzuf SAG of AK.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:21
items.html: (From SAG to MA and BON.)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:22
items.html: From the screen of Tabur of SAG, where surrounding light clashes with AHP. From the clash of surrounding light and inner light, the refinement of the screen is extended until it equalizes with Malchut of the Rosh, to receive renewal there from the coupling of the Rosh. 2. The incorporation of the screen in two kinds of records: records that are not connected with the records of NHY of the inner AK, and records that are connected with the records of the inner NHY, called Nekudot, in which the two Heys are connected together: the first Hey and the bottom Hey. 3. The concealment of the record of drawing from the last discernment.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:23
items.html: From the concealment of the last discernment of drawing, the diminution of the level to phase one is extended. 2. The formation of the two records into male and female.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:24
items.html: From the two records that were formed into male and female, the ascent of Malchut of the Rosh to Nikvey Einayim is extended. 2. A coupling was made there over phase two of clothing, which is the discernment of the male, and the level of Bina was extended; from it there is no expansion to the vessels. The coupling was made both over the records of Taamim and over the records of Nekudot. 3. The second coupling was made there in the discernment of the female, which is over phase one, and the level of ZA was extended over her. From it there is expansion to the vessels, and this coupling, too, was made both over the records of Taamim and over the records of Nekudot.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:25
items.html: From the incorporation of the records in the couplings of the Rosh at Nikvey Einayim, three actions are extended: 1. The renewal of the coarseness in the screen and the records that rose from the Guf of SAG, and they became fit for a coupling by striking. 2. The emergence of the Dikna in the discernment of the bottom Hey in the Einayim, and YHV in AHP. 3. The revelation of the coarseness of the Guf in the screen and records.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:26
items.html: From the descent of the screen to its corresponding discernment in the externality of the Guf, three Roshim are extended with its arrival at three places in the Guf: the Chazeh, the Tabur, and the Sium of the Guf, meaning the Sium of Tifferet of AK. From the Chazeh to the Peh of SAG, it elicited the ten Sefirot of the Rosh of the upper MA and BON, and its Guf ends above the Tabur of the inner AK. From the Tabur to the Chazeh of SAG, it elicited the ten Sefirot of the Rosh of YESHSUT, which is the first Rosh of Nekudim. From the Sium of the Guf upward to the Tabur, it elicited a second Rosh called GAR of Nekudim, and from the Sium of the Guf downward emerged the Guf of Nekudim, which are ZAT of Nekudim. In all of them there are male and female: the level of the male is up to Bina, and the level of the female is up to ZA. 2. The emergence of AHP from all the degrees.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 164:27
items.html: (to question) From the emergence of AHP from all the degrees, four actions are extended: 1. The diminution of Atzilut to Keter and Hochma alone, for AHP of the degree departed from it and are regarded as its Beria. 2. The correction of the Parsa. 3. A new boundary for the Sium of the line of Ein Sof, at the place of Bina of NHY of AK; Bina, ZA and Malchut of NHY of AK are below the point of Sium of the line of Ein Sof. This is called the second restriction. 4. The three Sefirot of NHY of AK that emerged below the point of the second restriction became the place for the three worlds of separation called BYA: Bina became the place of the world of Beria; ZA, the world of Yetzira; and Malchut, the world of Assiya.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 165:1
items.html: (to question) 1. The place where the restriction took place. 2. The records that remained after the restriction. 3. The ten Sefirot of circles. 4. The screen in the vessel of Malchut. 5. The extension of light once more. 6. The coupling by striking with the upper light. 7. The reflected light that became a garment and a vessel for the upper light. 8. The ten Sefirot of straightness from below upward, which are the beginning of the line. 9. The expansion of Malchut of the Rosh from above downward in the ten Sefirot from her and within her down to Tabur, which are the Toch of the line. 10. The expansion of the screen of Tabur in the ten Sefirot of Sium, where from Malchut of the Sium downward, it is darkness and not light.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 166:1
items.html: (to question) Four actions were extended by the departure of light on all four phases: the place for the worlds; the records, which are the ten Sefirot of circles; the awakening for the extension of light once more; the correction of the screen. The screen causes two actions: a coupling by striking and raising reflected light. The coupling by striking and the reflected light cause four actions: Rosh-Toch-Sof, and the point of restriction that ends the line.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 167:1
items.html: (to question) 1. The clash of surrounding light and inner light. 2. The refinement of the screen. 3. The incorporation of the screen in the records of the ten Sefirot of the Guf. 4. The two upper records: male and female. 5. Two kinds of coupling in the screen of the Rosh. 6. The renewal of the coarseness in the screen and the records. 7. The recognition of the coarseness of the Guf in them. 8. The concealment of the record of the last discernment from them. 9. Their departure from the Rosh. 10. Their arrival at the externality of the Guf of the previous Partzuf at the place of the Chazeh. 11. The coupling by striking made in the screen at the place of the Chazeh, extending the ten Sefirot of the Rosh. 12. The expansion of Malchut of the Rosh from the Chazeh downward. 13. Its clothing of the previous Partzuf. 14. Its beginning from the Peh of the upper one. (Inner Observation, item 11)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VI, List of Answers on Cause and Effect 168:1
items.html: (to question) The clash of surrounding light and inner light causes three actions: the refinement of the screen, the incorporation of the screen in the records, and the concealment of the last discernment. The concealment of the last discernment causes two actions: two records ZON, and two new couplings in the Rosh. The incorporation in the coupling of the Rosh causes the manifestation of the coarseness of the Guf. The manifestation of the coarseness of the Guf causes three actions: the exit from the Rosh, the arrival at its corresponding discernment in the externality of the Guf, and the new coupling at the place of the Chazeh. Three actions stem from the coupling in the Chazeh: Rosh-Toch-Sof. Two actions stem from the refinement of the screen and the departure of the lights of the Guf: the clothing of the lower one on the upper one, and the beginning of the level of the lower one from the Peh of the upper one.
